hero.headline: Made by Cambodians, for Cambodia.
hero.description: From Kampong Speu, LM MANUFACTURING CO., LTD. is developing instant noodles with a clear focus on hygienic working practices, consistent quality and the long-term growth of locally made products.
hero.imageAlt: Illustrative image of an instant noodle production line; not a photograph of the LM Manufacturing facility

intro.title: Local production built on hygiene and quality.
intro.text: We are building our manufacturing operation around careful preparation, clean and orderly working practices, responsible teams and continuous quality improvement—while helping strengthen confidence in products made in Cambodia.
intro.imageAlt: Illustrative image of a noodle production facility; not the company’s actual factory

productsDescription: Explore our growing instant noodle range, developed in Cambodia with attention to hygiene, quality and everyday convenience.
factoryText: See the people, spaces and working systems behind our manufacturing operation in Kampong Speu.
factoryImageAlt: Illustrative view of noodle production; not a company facility photograph

benefits.title: Clear ways of working
benefits.text: We organize daily work with practical procedures, clear responsibilities and strong coordination between teams.

benefits.title: People at the center
benefits.text: Our people are at the heart of our operation. We support teamwork, responsibility and learning as the business develops.

benefits.title: Always improving
benefits.text: We continuously strengthen our processes, systems and capabilities so the company can grow on a more reliable foundation.
